name: Itou Keita
source:
During the middle of the school year, he received a letter of admission from Bell Liberty Academy. Though he seems to be an average guy without any sort of special skills, he is a very warm and friendly person. The only skill he thought he had was luck. 
[spoiler]He seems to have forgotten who Kazuki is really. While he was young, he contracted the same virus that Hiroya Yoshizumi is infected with.[/spoiler]

[From [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gakuen_Heaven]Wikipedia[/url]]
